_what: The operator account's shared records that every account reads: show rules, per-account setup context, device releases, client programs the operator hosts, and the service brand. These are the names and limits the publish decisions in verify-every-port-publish-the-operators-shared-records-such-as-regional-records.mjs use. Storage, where the records live and how each region reads them are an owner ruling that is not made yet. labels: the record names a publication may carry. prefixes: a record name starts with one of these. read_seconds: how long a reader keeps one read. publish_most: how many records one publication sends. derived_labels: records the operator's store works out rather than keeps as a workspace record. own_record_sources: what writes a derived record, and which workspace labels or record types a record owner writes itself; a label listed here that is not derived is written by its owner and is not published by the operator's store.
